item.title: Putin eyes Mojtaba Khamenei's proxy for fighters as Russia hunts new manpower for Ukraine war
item.description: Ukraine’s intelligence service claims Russia is recruiting Yemeni nationals to fight in the war against Ukraine, alleging that at least 27 Yemenis have already received Russian passports. Kyiv says the recruitment pipeline involves Russia’s military and that some recruits were granted temporary citizenship under a Putin decree, raising fresh questions over Moscow’s use of foreign fighters.

item.title: 'Not my Chancellor': The AfD wave is growing, and Friedrich Merz may be Germany's next big casualty
item.description: Germany’s Friedrich Merz faces another bruising electoral test as voters in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania head to the polls, just weeks after the AfD’s 43.8% breakthrough in Saxony-Anhalt. In Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, polls have put Merz’s CDU perilously close to the 5% threshold needed to enter parliament. AfD candidate Leif-Erik Holm went further, declaring Merz would be “gone” if the CDU fell below that mark. Meanwhile, Berlin voters voiced frustration over living costs and established parties. With pressure already mounting inside conservative ranks, could another CDU setback deepen questions over Merz’s leadership?

item.title: Zelensky takes the fight to Moscow with Pelican, but has Ukraine pushed Russia too far this time?
item.description: Ukraine has unveiled a new ballistic weapon during a massive long-range attack on Moscow, with Zelensky confirming the Pelican was among the systems used. Kyiv said the operation marked the missile’s first combat use as strikes hit a key Russian oil facility and logistics site. Moscow’s Gazprom-operated refinery, which reportedly supplies around 40% of the capital’s fuel needs, caught fire during the barrage. Russia claimed a record 1,110 Ukrainian drones were intercepted nationwide before launching 138 drones at Ukraine. Has Zelensky’s new weapon opened a more dangerous phase in the battle over Putin’s energy lifelines?
